status.value: STOCK Act allows up to 45 days from trade to filing. Parsed 823 of 823 electronic House and 269 of 269 Senate reports filed since 2025-01-03. Lag is filed date minus trade date. Senate amendments keep the original report date and list the amendment date separately. A trade listed in more than one report counts once (104 repeat rows folded: 93 Senate amendment, 11 House; 11 take amended values); `public` is the earliest date it was disclosed, or the amendment date for a trade only in an amendment.
